## Maps and Tokens for Chapter 4

Session 4 transitions from the wilderness into the subterranean threshold:
Farbog Crossing &rarr; Germanic Village &rarr; Sacred Grove &amp; Sacrifice Circle &rarr; Skull Entrance &rarr; Ossuary.

Load maps before players join. The session begins with the Farbog and Village exploration, moves to the Sacred Grove confrontation, and culminates in the Skull Entrance and Ossuary crawl.

### NPC &amp; Key Tokens

No allied military garrison travels with the party:
- **Tribune Lucius is deceased** (slain in Session 3 spider ambush) — contubernium travels alone.
- **Centurion Varro is deceased** (executed at North Gate in Session 1).
- **Legate Corvinus &amp; Augur Cassia** remain at Fort Vindolanda.
- **Thusnelda (Völva Seer):** Token at the Sacrifice Circle in Scene 3.

| Token | File | Scene | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Thusnelda | `Maptool/tokens/npcs/named/Thusnelda.rptok` | Scene 3 (Sacrifice Circle) | Völva seer (he/him); ritual knife; 3 rounds to intervene. |
